title: Expert to Expert: Rich Hickey and Brian Beckman - Inside Clojure
summary: A Channel 9 Going Deep interview in which Brian Beckman talks with Rich Hickey, creator of Clojure, about the language's design. It covers Clojure's persistent data structures, reference types and its approach to concurrency on the JVM.
why: HN commenters call it a fantastic introduction to Clojure and the thinking behind its design.

quote.text: It's probably the best technical video I've ever watched on YouTube.
